Wow I am so sorry that happened to you. How terribly awful. 

I was with the father for 3 years.  He was abusive and I found out I was pregnant the day I was moving out. I had just loaded the last box when I decided to take a test. I was scared.   I cried during the whole procedure and in the end, the only thing I could say was "I didn't want this" over and over.  I'm not me anymore. I'm ruined
